name: Credential Access & Brute Force IR Runbook
containment_steps: Block offending source IP at border firewall or cloud security group
Temporarily lock targeted user accounts if multiple failed attempts observed
Terminate active sessions from the offending IP using loginctl or kill
investigation_steps: Verify whether authentication success occurred following failure bursts
Inspect auth.log / Event ID 4624 for secondary logon activity or session spawning
Cross-reference source IP against MISP and abuse database feeds
remediation_steps: Enforce mandatory password rotation for targeted user accounts
Ensure Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is strictly enforced
Disable root login over SSH (PermitRootLogin no in sshd_config)
